title: US Navy Sailors conduct demolition training during Sea Breeze 2026
description: PORTLAND PORT, England – (July 14, 2026) US Navy Sailors conduct demolition training during Sea Breeze 2026 in Portland, England, July 14, 2026. Sea Breeze 26 is an annual exercise co-sponsored by U.S. Naval Forces Europe-Africa and Marine Corps Forces Europe-Africa, designed to develop interoperability of maritime and ground forces in the Black Sea Region through combined NATO deliberate planning, integration, and command and control of Marine Amphibious Forces. (U.S. Navy video by Mass Communication Specialist 2nd Class Jonathan Nye)
